mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wallet_withdrawal_order WHERE user_id=#{user} AND client_request_id=#{key}
SELECT * FROM wallet_withdrawal_order WHERE order_no=#{no} FOR UPDATE
SELECT balance_cents,frozen_cents,income_available_cents FROM wallet_sandbox_account WHERE user_id=#{user} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_withdrawal_order SET provider='ALIPAY_SANDBOX_TRANSFER',payee_user_id=#{payee}, sandbox_app_id=#{app},sandbox_seller_id=#{seller},transfer_state='NOT_STARTED',transfer_error_code=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{no} AND status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED') AND transfer_started_at IS NULL

UPDATE wallet_withdrawal_order SET transfer_state='PROCESSING', transfer_started_at=COALESCE(transfer_started_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), last_transfer_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),transfer_lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,120,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)),version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{no} AND status='APPROVED' AND (transfer_lease_until IS NULL OR transfer_lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND (last_transfer_at IS NULL OR last_transfer_at < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-5,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)))
UPDATE wallet_withdrawal_order SET transfer_state=#{state},transfer_error_code=#{code},transfer_lease_until=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{no} AND status='APPROVED'
UPDATE wallet_withdrawal_order SET status='REJECTED',version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{no} AND status='APPROVED'
mapper.select: SELECT order_no FROM wallet_withdrawal_order WHERE user_id=#{user} AND status='APPROVED' AND provider='ALIPAY_SANDBOX_TRANSFER' AND transfer_started_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last_transfer_at,order_no LIMIT 3
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_sandbox_account SET income_available_cents=income_available_cents-#{amount},balance_cents=balance_cents-#{amount},frozen_cents=frozen_cents+#{amount},version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{user} AND balance_cents>=#{amount} AND income_available_cents>=#{amount}

UPDATE wallet_withdrawal_order SET status=#{status},review_note=#{note},reviewed_by=#{ops},reviewed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),expected_payout_date=#{due},version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{no} AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE wallet_withdrawal_order SET status='COMPLETED',completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),payout_reference=#{reference},version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{no} AND status='APPROVED'
mapper.select: SELECT o.*,d.real_name doctor_name FROM wallet_withdrawal_order o LEFT JOIN consultation_doctor d ON d.user_id=o.user_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.order_no DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT order_no FROM wallet_withdrawal_order WHERE status='APPROVED' AND expected_payout_date<=#{today} AND provider='ALIPAY_SANDBOX_TRANSFER' AND payee_user_id IS NOT NULL AND (transfer_lease_until IS NULL OR transfer_lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY last_transfer_at,expected_payout_date,order_no LIMIT 50
SELECT working_day FROM wallet_work_calendar WHERE calendar_date=#{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_work_calendar(calendar_date,working_day,note,updated_by) VALUES(#{date},#{working},#{note},#{ops}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE working_day=#{working},note=#{note},updated_by=#{ops},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT calendar_date,working_day,note FROM wallet_work_calendar WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY calendar_date
